price_basis.same_date_factor: A common adjusted-close factor applied to O and C cancels within same-day C/O, but changes across dates enter the overnight leg. The economic treatment of distributions must be stated separately from a cash dividend received by an actual portfolio.
price_basis.cross_field_risk: If an early segment has O*=kO*O and C*=kC*C, its daily log day leg is shifted by log(kC/kO), and its night leg by the opposite term when endpoints remain in that segment. The sum can telescope correctly while the day/night contrast is shifted. This is a symbolic measurement-risk argument, not a computed label or evidence of a material realized bias.
